page.content:
Last bleeding at Kirklees and the grave-arrow.

How Death of Robin Hood connects

  • Location: Kirklees Priory — Robin dies at Kirklees Priory.
  • Character: Prioress of Kirklees — The prioress bleeds Robin to death under color of care.
  • Artist: Little John — Little John answers the last horn at Kirklees.

What is Death of Robin Hood?

The death of Robin Hood closes the Gest-derived cycle: sickness, the prioress's knife or basin, the horn for Little John, and the arrow that marks the grave.

Key threads lead to Kirklees Priory, Prioress of Kirklees and Little John.
